# PrimitiveOS PDF password support

This is the published `hayro-syntax` 0.9.0 source at upstream revision `3f3825c3e50bb41ed6ec6c3f4b6007978bd13def`. Reader accepts a valid owner credential on Standard Security Handler revisions 2 through 4. It uses the existing user-password authentication and existing RC4/MD5 routines. The existing Reader PDFDocEncoding character map is shared by metadata decoding and legacy password input. The added cross-reference flag reports whether reading used a security handler, including an empty reading password. The upstream crate accepts user credentials for these revisions and both roles on revisions 5 and 6. [Upstream crate source](https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro/tree/3f3825c3e50bb41ed6ec6c3f4b6007978bd13def/hayro-syntax) · [ISO 32000-1, section 7.6.3.4](https://udp.adobe.io/document-services/docs/assets/35e4369068f86065372c18787171a17e/PDF_ISO_32000-1.pdf)

The original Apache 2.0 and MIT license texts accompany this source and the Reader package. The local changes are confined to the crypto module, the character mapping in the string module and its export, and the cross-reference query.
